Kangana Ranaut Questions Officials on Unspent Development Funds

BJP MP Kangana Ranaut confronted officials in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, regarding delays and unspent funds allocated for Centre-sponsored schemes and Member of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS). Ranaut expressed frustration, stating that the funds should not remain confined to paperwork and questioned the officials' handling of the money. She specifically cited delays related to ₹11 crore in MPLADS funds. Ranaut's remarks were made in the presence of media.
